summary: CLAIM C-0005: Alternative/non-ramp lifting proposals exist (pulley-like counterweights 2025, hydraulic lift for Djoser, cast-in-place concrete) but remain minority, non-consensus hypotheses.
content: Radical alternatives to ramps exist but are not consensus: a 2025 npj paper proposes pulley-like counterweight systems on sliding ramps (EV-0002); a 2024 PLoS ONE paper proposes a hydraulic lift for the Step Pyramid of Djoser (EV-0011 context); the 'cast-in-place' theory of Davidovits is contradicted by the Merer diary documenting intact stones shipped by boat (EV-0007). These are minority hypotheses, not established consensus.
